description: Late-bound Onesimus views: every view of v2251/v2252 reads a set-returning SQL function with a string body (onesimus.fn_vw_*) instead of the Bareos tables, so no Onesimus object depends on a table in public and Bareos upgrades (update_bareos_tables: ALTER COLUMN TYPE, DROP COLUMN, DROP TABLE) are never blocked; view names, columns and types stay the same
author: Onesimus

views.name: onesimus.vw_job_summary
views.description: Zusammenfassung aller Jobs mit Client- und Pool-Namen; reads only onesimus.fn_vw_job_summary() (no dependency on Bareos tables), same columns and types as before
views.query: SELECT jobid, job, jobname, type::character(1) AS type, level::character(1) AS level, jobstatus::character(1) AS jobstatus, schedtime, starttime, endtime, jobfiles, jobbytes, joberrors, volsessionid, volsessiontime, clientname, poolname FROM onesimus.fn_vw_job_summary()

views.name: onesimus.vw_volume_status
views.description: Volume-Status mit Pool-Name und Fuellstand; reads only onesimus.fn_vw_volume_status() (no dependency on Bareos tables), same columns and types as before
views.query: SELECT mediaid, volumename, volstatus, volbytes, voljobs, volfiles, volmounts, volerrors, maxvolbytes, mediatype, slot, poolname, pct_full FROM onesimus.fn_vw_volume_status()

views.name: onesimus.vw_last_backup_per_client
views.description: Letzter erfolgreicher Backup pro Client; reads only onesimus.fn_vw_last_backup_per_client() (no dependency on Bareos tables), same columns and types as before
views.query: SELECT clientname, jobid, jobname, level::character(1) AS level, starttime, endtime, jobfiles, jobbytes FROM onesimus.fn_vw_last_backup_per_client() ORDER BY clientname

views.name: onesimus.vw_file_list
views.description: Dateiliste mit Pfaden (ersetzt den fehleranfaelligen filename-Join); reads only onesimus.fn_vw_file_list() (no dependency on Bareos tables), same columns and types as before
views.query: SELECT fileid, jobid, filepath, fileindex, markid FROM onesimus.fn_vw_file_list()

views.name: onesimus.vw_running_jobs
views.description: Aktuell laufende Jobs (status dir); reads only onesimus.fn_vw_running_jobs() (no dependency on Bareos tables), same columns and types as before
views.query: SELECT jobid, job, jobname, type::character(1) AS type, level::character(1) AS level, jobstatus::character(1) AS jobstatus, starttime, jobfiles, jobbytes, joberrors, clientname, volsessionid, volsessiontime FROM onesimus.fn_vw_running_jobs()

views.name: onesimus.vw_media_list
views.description: Alle Volumes mit Pool-Name (fuer .media Completion); reads only onesimus.fn_vw_media_list() (no dependency on Bareos tables), same columns and types as before
views.query: SELECT mediaid, volumename, volstatus, mediatype, volbytes, voljobs, volfiles, maxvolbytes, poolname FROM onesimus.fn_vw_media_list() ORDER BY volumename

functions.name: onesimus.fn_vw_job_summary
functions.description: Rows of the view onesimus.vw_job_summary (Zusammenfassung aller Jobs mit Client- und Pool-Namen). Late-bound SQL body (string, not BEGIN ATOMIC): PostgreSQL records no dependency on the Bareos tables, so update_bareos_tables may alter or drop their columns; every column is cast to the type the view has always had.
functions.returns: TABLE(jobid integer, job text, jobname text, type character, level character, jobstatus character, schedtime timestamp without time zone, starttime timestamp without time zone, endtime timestamp without time zone, jobfiles integer, jobbytes bigint, joberrors integer, volsessionid integer, volsessiontime integer, clientname text, poolname text)
functions.body: SELECT j.jobid::integer, j.job::text, j.name::text, j.type::character(1), j.level::character(1), j.jobstatus::character(1), j.schedtime::timestamp without time zone, j.starttime::timestamp without time zone, j.endtime::timestamp without time zone, j.jobfiles::integer, j.jobbytes::bigint, j.joberrors::integer, j.volsessionid::integer, j.volsessiontime::integer, c.name::text, p.name::text FROM job j LEFT JOIN client c ON j.clientid = c.clientid LEFT JOIN pool p ON j.poolid = p.poolid;

functions.name: onesimus.fn_vw_volume_status
functions.description: Rows of the view onesimus.vw_volume_status (Volume-Status mit Pool-Name und Fuellstand). Late-bound SQL body (string, not BEGIN ATOMIC): PostgreSQL records no dependency on the Bareos tables, so update_bareos_tables may alter or drop their columns; every column is cast to the type the view has always had.
functions.returns: TABLE(mediaid integer, volumename text, volstatus text, volbytes bigint, voljobs bigint, volfiles bigint, volmounts bigint, volerrors bigint, maxvolbytes bigint, mediatype text, slot bigint, poolname text, pct_full numeric)
functions.body: SELECT m.mediaid::integer, m.volumename::text, m.volstatus::text, m.volbytes::bigint, m.voljobs::bigint, m.volfiles::bigint, m.volmounts::bigint, m.volerrors::bigint, m.maxvolbytes::bigint, m.mediatype::text, m.slot::bigint, p.name::text, (CASE WHEN m.maxvolbytes > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * m.volbytes / m.maxvolbytes, 1) ELSE 0 END)::numeric FROM media m LEFT JOIN pool p ON m.poolid = p.poolid;

functions.name: onesimus.fn_vw_last_backup_per_client
functions.description: Rows of the view onesimus.vw_last_backup_per_client (Letzter erfolgreicher Backup pro Client). Late-bound SQL body (string, not BEGIN ATOMIC): PostgreSQL records no dependency on the Bareos tables, so update_bareos_tables may alter or drop their columns; every column is cast to the type the view has always had.
functions.returns: TABLE(clientname text, jobid integer, jobname text, level character, starttime timestamp without time zone, endtime timestamp without time zone, jobfiles integer, jobbytes bigint)
functions.body: SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.name) c.name::text, j.jobid::integer, j.name::text, j.level::character(1), j.starttime::timestamp without time zone, j.endtime::timestamp without time zone, j.jobfiles::integer, j.jobbytes::bigint FROM job j JOIN client c ON j.clientid = c.clientid WHERE j.type = 'B' AND j.jobstatus = 'T' ORDER BY c.name, j.starttime DESC;

functions.name: onesimus.fn_vw_file_list
functions.description: Rows of the view onesimus.vw_file_list (Dateiliste mit Pfaden (ersetzt den fehleranfaelligen filename-Join)). Late-bound SQL body (string, not BEGIN ATOMIC): PostgreSQL records no dependency on the Bareos tables, so update_bareos_tables may alter or drop their columns; every column is cast to the type the view has always had.
functions.returns: TABLE(fileid bigint, jobid integer, filepath text, fileindex integer, markid integer)
functions.body: SELECT f.fileid::bigint, f.jobid::integer, (p.path || f.name)::text, f.fileindex::integer, f.markid::integer FROM file f JOIN path p ON f.pathid = p.pathid;

functions.name: onesimus.fn_vw_running_jobs
functions.description: Rows of the view onesimus.vw_running_jobs (Aktuell laufende Jobs (status dir)). Late-bound SQL body (string, not BEGIN ATOMIC): PostgreSQL records no dependency on the Bareos tables, so update_bareos_tables may alter or drop their columns; every column is cast to the type the view has always had.
functions.returns: TABLE(jobid integer, job text, jobname text, type character, level character, jobstatus character, starttime timestamp without time zone, jobfiles integer, jobbytes bigint, joberrors integer, clientname text, volsessionid integer, volsessiontime integer)
functions.body: SELECT j.jobid::integer, j.job::text, j.name::text, j.type::character(1), j.level::character(1), j.jobstatus::character(1), j.starttime::timestamp without time zone, j.jobfiles::integer, j.jobbytes::bigint, j.joberrors::integer, c.name::text, j.volsessionid::integer, j.volsessiontime::integer FROM job j LEFT JOIN client c ON j.clientid = c.clientid WHERE j.jobstatus IN ('R', 'C', 'B', 'e', 'D', 'F', 'S', 'm', 'M', 's', 'j', 'c', 'd', 't', 'p', 'i', 'a', 'l', 'L');

functions.name: onesimus.fn_vw_media_list
functions.description: Rows of the view onesimus.vw_media_list (Alle Volumes mit Pool-Name (fuer .media Completion)). Late-bound SQL body (string, not BEGIN ATOMIC): PostgreSQL records no dependency on the Bareos tables, so update_bareos_tables may alter or drop their columns; every column is cast to the type the view has always had.
functions.returns: TABLE(mediaid integer, volumename text, volstatus text, mediatype text, volbytes bigint, voljobs bigint, volfiles bigint, maxvolbytes bigint, poolname text)
functions.body: SELECT m.mediaid::integer, m.volumename::text, m.volstatus::text, m.mediatype::text, m.volbytes::bigint, m.voljobs::bigint, m.volfiles::bigint, m.maxvolbytes::bigint, p.name::text FROM media m LEFT JOIN pool p ON m.poolid = p.poolid ORDER BY m.volumename;
